query: Please implement a form validation website to validate user input information. The website should have functionalities to validate email addresses, required text fields, minimum length, maximum length, and letters and spaces only. Users should be able to input information, submit the form, and view the validation results. Configure your theme with salmon as background and crimson as component color.
